prompt:
UI design mockup of the project screen of an AI software factory: the one screen a person uses to steer a software project that AI agents build. Desktop browser viewport, 16:9, flat, no browser chrome, no device frame, the screen fills the whole image.

Three elements in order of weight: the pulse (one sentence, what to know now) on top; the chat with the project agent as the main affordance, the place a person acts; the kanban board for the granular task state, quiet, scanned not read. Normal states whisper, exceptional states speak: the two items in Needs you are the loudest things on the screen, a done card is quiet.

The same busy moment as before, but the card "#601 Console: the drawer's Overview top block" is open: its drawer docks at the right edge of the screen over the board, 46 percent wide, and the chat stays visible and free. The drawer shows: the header "#601 Console: the drawer's Overview top block" with the state "running · 23 min · 3/4 checks" and "€1.72 / €2.00 ⚠ near its budget"; tabs "Overview", "Chat", "Activity", "Files" with Chat selected; the line "Session 2 · coding-cheap · running"; messages: agent "The top block is in place as a definition list. Running the Overview test next.", sebastian "Keep the budget line muted under 80 percent.", agent "Done: the budget line takes the muted class until 80 percent, then the warning sign."; a message box "Message the running session; it reads it at its next step" with "Send". Under the drawer's edge the board's remaining columns are partly covered. The pulse and the status figures stay on top. The content of the board and the chat is the same as before (the Needs you items "Merge PR #612" and "#603 Which store for the session table?", the columns Queued 4, Working 3, Verifying 2, Done 8, the chat with the proposal "I will: answer #603 with Postgres, then move #620 to ready" and its buttons "Do it" and "Skip").

Direction "Swiss grid": Swiss typographic style, Josef Müller-Brockmann. A strict 12-column grid, Helvetica-like grotesk, one red as the only colour, black and white otherwise, rules not boxes. The status figures as big numerals (3, 2, €61.40), the pulse as a 32 px headline. Layout: the chat and the board as two equal columns, left and right, with the pulse spanning both on top. Light is white paper; dark is black with white rules. Dark theme.

Legible UI text with exact spelling, nothing invented. Made by a top product design studio. Not a template, not a slide deck, not a generic admin dashboard.
label: 04-swiss-grid-drawer
